reading: A bridge in Kyiv was hit by a Russian drone.
Vehicles were moving on the bridge when it was hit.
The drone attack created a large fireball and black smoke.
Major bridges in Kyiv have been hit by drones for four days.
Two people were injured in the latest attack.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv to show support.
He met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
The damaged bridges are still standing, but traffic is difficult.

vocabulary.definition: a small aircraft that flies without a person inside
machines like cars or trucks that carry people or things
a large, bright ball of fire
help or agreement for someone or something
